desc:
🌲 BUILD. DEFEND. SURVIVE. 🌙

The forest is peaceful during the day... but when night falls, the monsters come.

🏗️ Build your own fortress
🔫 Defend it with turrets, traps & weapons
💰 Earn Cash and unlock stronger gear
👾 Survive increasingly dangerous nights
🏆 Complete Feats and become unstoppable

Every day is your chance to prepare.
Every night puts your build to the test.

Will you create an unstoppable fortress... or get destroyed when the sun goes down?

⭐ LIKE the game + JOIN the group for a FREE Medium Turret!
👥 Playing with friends makes surviving even better!

Build your fortress. Survive the night. Become unstoppable.
